mechanism: Cache the end of a previously verified match at the same distance. Because each SF collector visits increasing positions, its overlap is already known; extend only the remaining suffix with the original matcher. A256-slot direct map stores distance and end, with fallback on misses and bounds.
difference_from_old_work: R19 transferred base-engine candidate prefixes across stages and added large cache plumbing; this cache is local to each SF collector and reuses exact prior SF comparisons. It never replaces the search or changes candidate admission. Extra read/write cost is measured.
